title: Game facts docs
question: Should we keep what the game is in one set of docs under docs/game/, one file per area, updated in the same commit as every game change and checked against the game by a script?

options.label: adopt: as proposed
options.note: Write the other area files one at a time, add the check to the fast test and push script, point the bible at docs/game, then move the old docs.

options.label: adopt-changes: adopt with changes
options.note: Say what to change in the comment.

options.label: rethink
options.note: Say what's wrong with the approach in the comment.

links.label: The proposal (a few minutes to read)
The check for the cast: tools/facts/check.mjs

decision: Adopted with his change: people and places described as facts (routines, schedules), the story kept as one file per storyline in docs/game/stories/, no linear walkthrough.
